title: BIRD-INTERACT: Re-imagining Text-to-SQL Evaluation via Lens of Dynamic Interactions

layout.note: A narrow left column stacks the task block, the actor stack and the database block; a wide framed panel on the right holds the transcript in two columns of three interactions each, alternating avatar bubbles and code blocks.

lesson: For an interactive benchmark, put a narrow setting column (task, hidden intent, cast, database) next to a framed transcript of numbered interactions, each turn an avatar bubble with a move tag; red text follows the ambiguity from spec to dialogue.
